info.title: Connectivity and internal app foundation
info.description: Feature-disabled local health remains unauthenticated. Vercel and app-enabled local mode require the technical bearer on all non-preflight requests. Opt-in /v1/app operations additionally require a verified current user token. No public bootstrap/password API. FE generated consumer updates and production schema-changing delivery are separately coordinated.

get.description: Exact configured Host/raw path only; single-use transaction-authenticated callback. Success query is exactly state+code; denial is state+error with optional error_description/error_uri. Maximum4096 bytes; duplicate and unknown fields rejected. No public status or confirmation page.
